finish_summary: 1) bulk_discount_percent returns 5% for quantity 49 but specification requires 10%. 2) parse_coupon does not strip surrounding whitespace or handle case-insensitive matching; it raises ValueError for code with spaces like ' save20 '. 3) remove_item leaves item with quantity 0 in cart instead of removing it entirely. 4) total with an invalid coupon string does not raise ValueError, violating specification that parsing a bad coupon must raise.
